result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make it easier for people to understand one another deeply — not just language, but perspectives, experiences, and intentions.

So much conflict, injustice, and loneliness seems to grow from misunderstanding or the inability to be truly heard. If empathy and clear communication were more effortless, many other problems might become easier to solve together.
